Photograph of the white-border [[Big One: Asteroid Cave Or Space Slug Belly (Dark) (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The complete photograph is available at the linked original image URL. The photographer is not identified in the retained acquisition evidence.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/-tQAAeSwXbZp~6DQ/s-l1600.webp complete card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1600 × 1200-pixel native photograph is retained separately. The whole source was rotated 0 degrees counterclockwise, then rectangle (0, 0)–(1600, 1200) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. It was downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 467 × 350 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons, legal text and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. Where the source photograph itself meets the canvas boundary, no unseen outer paper was synthesized. The photograph or acquisition date does not establish the card’s first publication date.
